subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Should `sessions cleanup` retain the PR's conservative rule that a shared archive directory is only cleaned when all configured owners are selected, rather than deleting retention-expired archives during a single-agent cleanup?
rationale: The branch is technically coherent and proves its intended behavior, but this determines when an operator command may permanently delete files in a directory that another configured agent also uses; source-level correctness cannot choose that product safety policy.

options.title: Approve conservative shared-directory cleanup
options.body: Merge the current approach: skip archive deletion for a selected agent when an unselected configured agent shares the directory, and deduplicate deletion when all owners are selected.

options.title: Require selective ownership attribution
options.body: Pause the PR until session archives can be reliably attributed to their owning agent, allowing safe single-agent cleanup without leaving shared-directory archives behind.

recommendation.title: Approve conservative shared-directory cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach: skip archive deletion for a selected agent when an unselected configured agent shares the directory, and deduplicate deletion when all owners are selected.
